During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 1122 requests to 193 third-party domains (median of 1 passes).
Of 14.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 11.4 MB (77%) came from third-party domains, 2.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (575 requests).

90 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising).
